diluent_from.He: He initial ambient composition; mole fraction

notes: Droplet-combustion suppression study (liquid, idealized fuels: methanol/heptane). O2 is a mole fraction -> x100. Pressure in mmHg (~760 -> ~14.7 psi). sample_size_mm uses the initial droplet diameter. Metric header reads 'Burning rate; mm' but droplet burning rate is an area rate (mm2/s); kept as burning_rate. diluent_from picks the dominant inert; note the 'CO initial ambient composition' header is treated as the CO2 diluent fraction (values up to 0.7 indicate a major diluent, i.e. CO2, not trace CO) - flagged for review. No airflow (quiescent droplet).
